english: Read cv_label_images.py in full and audit every place that accesses roi.x1, roi.y1, roi.x2, or roi.y2 directly (i.e. NOT via roi.coords). Specifically check: ROISelectorWindow.draw_roi (uses roi.x1 etc for canvas.create_rectangle -- tkinter handles inverted fine, but text placement might be wrong); save_labels / export CSV (writing raw values to file -- these should stay raw so the file reflects actual stored data); update_roi_list display text; Any other drawing or cropping call. Make only necessary fixes. Do not refactor anything unrelated.
pseudocode: <PLAN><STEP> READ cv_label_images.py FULL <STEP> AUDIT roi.x1, roi.y1, roi.x2, roi.y2 FOR direct_access_not_via_coords <STEP> FIX inverted_coordinate_bugs WHERE crash_or_wrong_behavior USING roi.coords </PLAN>
